LanguageData.STB_FeedFromHoppersDesc: If on, this machine takes fuel from any hopper touching it whenever it drops below its target fuel level. Works with the fuel hopper, the vanilla hopper, and Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Factory hoppers. Turn off to keep a hopper's contents for something else.
LanguageData.STB_PollutesWhileBurning: Pollutes about {0} cells a day while burning
